title: Gazetteer manifest
description: Manifest describing the bundled surname and given-name Bloom filter assets, and — in the shipped form written by `resecta-data manifest-assets` — every installed engine asset's SHA-256 and size. Decoded by GazetteerManifest.swift. Field names must match the Codable case names on the Swift side exactly.

version.description: Semantic version of the gazetteer asset bundle. Bump on any format change the Swift decoder must observe.

hashAlgorithm.description: Identifier of the hash family used to build the Bloom filters. Must match the Swift BloomFilter implementation.

seed.description: Hash seed shared by both filters. Only the lower 32 bits are consumed by MurmurHash3.

assets.description: Shipped form only (version 1.1.0): one entry per asset install-assets routes into the engine bundle, except the manifest, its signature and the public key. Sorted by path. The engine verifies each file's SHA-256 and size against its entry at first load.

path.description: Bundle-relative path under the engine resource bundle.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the installed bytes.

bytes.description: Byte count of the installed file.

filters.description: Per-filter metadata. One entry per .bloom file shipped to Resources/Gazetteers/.

type.description: Swift-side type code used to route membership queries.

m.description: Bit-array size in bits. Must be a multiple of 8 so the array is byte-aligned.

k.description: Number of hash functions. Upper bound is advisory, not enforced by the format.

fprTarget.description: Target false-positive rate used to size m.

sources.description: Identifiers of the source corpora that contributed keys. Resolves to SOURCES.md rows.

builtAt.description: Build timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC. For deterministic builds this is pinned to the canonical build date.
